I am just checking in again to see if you had any comments on the living room location, so we can move that area
forward. You had asked for sketches with some minor adjustments to play around with. Attached are the images I sent
you last week.
*      Raise the floor level 3'.
•      Shift the living room east.
•      Center the living room on the pool/move the stair.
